## The test code

```ts
/**
 * Issue #82 — unit tests for the pure layering logic in `ownership.ts`.
 * Expected values come from the acceptance criteria in #82 and the decisions
 * approved on it (Phase 1):
 *
 * - A: rows (incl. my own and the miscellaneous bucket) can be moved up/down
 *   one place or dragged to any position; the ends can't move further
 * - B: switch off → shared order untouched; on → a higher row's elements are
 *   drawn above every element of a lower row, shared order kept within a row;
 *   the order survives switching off and on
 * - D: a bound label is drawn directly with its container
 * - E: elements are never changed (index/version)
 * - G: hidden/locked collaborators keep their place
 * - H: a collaborator appearing for the first time goes to the bottom
 * - default order (decision on #82): me on top, then join order (#116's
 *   collaborator directory, in the order it was filled), miscellaneous last
 *
 * Arrays of elements are in drawing order: first = drawn first (bottom),
 * last = drawn last (top). Layer orders are top row first.
 */
import { arrayToMap } from "@excalidraw/common";

import { newElement, newTextElement } from "../newElement";
import {
  CREATOR_ID_KEY,
  UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID,
  getCollaboratorLayerOrder,
  getDefaultCollaboratorLayerOrder,
  moveCollaboratorLayer,
  orderElementsByCollaboratorLayer,
} from "../ownership";

import type { ExcalidrawElement } from "../types";

const createRect = (id: string, creatorId?: string) =>
  newElement({
    type: "rectangle",
    id,
    x: 0,
    y: 0,
    customData:
      creatorId === undefined ? undefined : { [CREATOR_ID_KEY]: creatorId },
  });

const createLabel = (id: string, containerId: string, creatorId: string) =>
  newTextElement({
    id,
    text: "label",
    containerId,
    x: 0,
    y: 0,
    customData: { [CREATOR_ID_KEY]: creatorId },
  });

const ids = (elements: readonly ExcalidrawElement[]) =>
  elements.map((element) => element.id);

/** directory as #116 fills it: insertion order = order first seen */
const directory = (...clientIds: string[]) =>
  new Map(clientIds.map((id) => [id, { username: id, lastSeen: 0 }]));

/** `collaborators` as the editor stores them; the first entry is me */
const room = (...clientIds: string[]) =>
  new Map(
    clientIds.map((id, i) => [`${id}-socket`, { id, isCurrentUser: i === 0 }]),
  );

/** me, alice and bob in the room; alice joined before bob */
const baseState = {
  collaborators: room("me", "alice", "bob"),
  collaboratorDirectory: directory("alice", "bob"),
};

const layered = (
  collaboratorLayerOrder: readonly string[] | null,
  extra: Record<string, unknown> = {},
) => ({
  ...baseState,
  collaboratorLayeringEnabled: true,
  collaboratorLayerOrder,
  ...extra,
});

describe("orderElementsByCollaboratorLayer (the single ordering function)", () => {
  // shared order: alice's shape at the bottom, then mine, then bob's on top
  const aliceRect = createRect("alice-rect", "alice");
  const myRect = createRect("my-rect", "me");
  const bobRect = createRect("bob-rect", "bob");
  const shared = [aliceRect, myRect, bobRect];

  it("AC-B: with the switch off, the original array is returned unchanged", () => {
    const result = orderElementsByCollaboratorLayer(shared, {
      ...baseState,
      collaboratorLayeringEnabled: false,
      collaboratorLayerOrder: ["alice", "me", "bob", UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID],
    });
    expect(result).toBe(shared);
  });

  it("AC-B: (control) the same setup with the switch on does change the order", () => {
    const result = orderElementsByCollaboratorLayer(
      shared,
      layered(["alice", "me", "bob", UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID]),
    );
    expect(ids(result)).not.toEqual(ids(shared));
  });

  it("AC-B: with no layering state at all, the original array is returned", () => {
    expect(orderElementsByCollaboratorLayer(shared, baseState)).toBe(shared);
  });

  it("AC-B: a higher collaborator is drawn above a lower one", () => {
    // alice top, bob bottom → bob drawn first, alice last
    const result = orderElementsByCollaboratorLayer(
      shared,
      layered(["alice", "me", "bob", UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID]),
    );
    expect(ids(result)).toEqual(["bob-rect", "my-rect", "alice-rect"]);
  });

  it("AC-B: every element of a higher collaborator is above every element of a lower one, even when interleaved", () => {
    const a1 = createRect("a1", "alice");
    const b1 = createRect("b1", "bob");
    const a2 = createRect("a2", "alice");
    const b2 = createRect("b2", "bob");
    const result = orderElementsByCollaboratorLayer(
      [a1, b1, a2, b2],
      layered(["alice", "bob", "me", UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID]),
    );
    expect(ids(result)).toEqual(["b1", "b2", "a1", "a2"]);
  });

  it("AC-B: within one collaborator, elements keep the shared drawing order", () => {
    const a1 = createRect("a1", "alice");
    const a2 = createRect("a2", "alice");
    const a3 = createRect("a3", "alice");
    const b1 = createRect("b1", "bob");
    const result = orderElementsByCollaboratorLayer(
      [a3, b1, a1, a2],
      layered(["alice", "bob", "me", UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID]),
    );
    expect(ids(result)).toEqual(["b1", "a3", "a1", "a2"]);
  });

  it("AC-B: the stored order is used again after switching off and on", () => {
    const order = ["alice", "me", "bob", UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID];
    expect(
      orderElementsByCollaboratorLayer(shared, {
        ...layered(order),
        collaboratorLayeringEnabled: false,
      }),
    ).toBe(shared);
    expect(
      ids(orderElementsByCollaboratorLayer(shared, layered(order))),
    ).toEqual(["bob-rect", "my-rect", "alice-rect"]);
  });

  it("AC-D: a bound label is drawn directly with its container, even when the label has another creator", () => {
    // alice's shape carries a label stamped by bob; bob is on top
    const container = createRect("container", "alice");
    const label = createLabel("label", "container", "bob");
    const bobShape = createRect("bob-shape", "bob");
    const elements = [container, bobShape, label];
    const result = orderElementsByCollaboratorLayer(
      elements,
      layered(["bob", "alice", "me", UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID]),
      arrayToMap(elements),
    );
    expect(ids(result)).toEqual(["container", "label", "bob-shape"]);
  });

  it("AC-A: the miscellaneous bucket can be ordered (untagged and never-seen creators)", () => {
    const untagged = createRect("untagged");
    const stranger = createRect("stranger-rect", "stranger");
    const result = orderElementsByCollaboratorLayer(
      [untagged, stranger, aliceRect],
      layered([UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID, "alice", "me", "bob"]),
    );
    expect(ids(result)).toEqual(["alice-rect", "untagged", "stranger-rect"]);
  });

  it("AC-A: my own row can be ordered (moved below a collaborator)", () => {
    const result = orderElementsByCollaboratorLayer(
      [myRect, aliceRect],
      layered(["alice", "me", "bob", UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID]),
    );
    expect(ids(result)).toEqual(["my-rect", "alice-rect"]);
  });

  it("AC-G: hiding or locking a collaborator doesn't change their place", () => {
    const order = ["alice", "me", "bob", UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID];
    const expected = ["bob-rect", "my-rect", "alice-rect"];
    expect(
      ids(
        orderElementsByCollaboratorLayer(
          shared,
          layered(order, { hiddenCollaboratorIds: new Set(["alice"]) }),
        ),
      ),
    ).toEqual(expected);
    expect(
      ids(
        orderElementsByCollaboratorLayer(
          shared,
          layered(order, { lockedCollaboratorIds: new Set(["alice"]) }),
        ),
      ),
    ).toEqual(expected);
  });

  it("AC-H: elements of a creator missing from the order are drawn below everyone", () => {
    // outside a room there's no directory: every stamped creator is a bucket
    const carolRect = createRect("carol-rect", "carol");
    const result = orderElementsByCollaboratorLayer([aliceRect, carolRect], {
      collaborators: room("me", "alice"),
      collaboratorDirectory: null,
      collaboratorLayeringEnabled: true,
      collaboratorLayerOrder: ["alice", "me", UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID],
    });
    expect(ids(result)).toEqual(["carol-rect", "alice-rect"]);
  });

  it("AC-E: changes no element and doesn't mutate the input array", () => {
    const before = shared.map((el) => ({
      id: el.id,
      index: el.index,
      version: el.version,
      versionNonce: el.versionNonce,
    }));
    const input = [...shared];
    orderElementsByCollaboratorLayer(
      input,
      layered(["alice", "me", "bob", UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID]),
    );
    expect(ids(input)).toEqual(ids(shared));
    expect(
      input.map((el) => ({
        id: el.id,
        index: el.index,
        version: el.version,
        versionNonce: el.versionNonce,
      })),
    ).toEqual(before);
  });
});

describe("getDefaultCollaboratorLayerOrder (first switch-on and Reset)", () => {
  it("default: me on top, then join order, miscellaneous at the bottom", () => {
    expect(getDefaultCollaboratorLayerOrder(baseState)).toEqual([
      "me",
      "alice",
      "bob",
      UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID,
    ]);
  });

  it("default: join order is the directory's order, not the room's", () => {
    // bob was seen first (e.g. previously seen), alice later
    expect(
      getDefaultCollaboratorLayerOrder({
        collaborators: room("me", "alice", "bob"),
        collaboratorDirectory: directory("bob", "alice"),
      }),
    ).toEqual(["me", "bob", "alice", UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID]);
  });

  it("default: me on top even when I'm late in the directory", () => {
    expect(
      getDefaultCollaboratorLayerOrder({
        collaborators: room("me", "alice"),
        collaboratorDirectory: directory("alice", "me"),
      }),
    ).toEqual(["me", "alice", UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID]);
  });

  it("default: previously seen collaborators (not in the room) keep their place in join order", () => {
    expect(
      getDefaultCollaboratorLayerOrder({
        collaborators: room("me", "bob"),
        collaboratorDirectory: directory("alice", "bob"),
      }),
    ).toEqual(["me", "alice", "bob", UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID]);
  });

  it("default: a live collaborator not yet in the directory comes after it, above miscellaneous", () => {
    expect(
      getDefaultCollaboratorLayerOrder({
        collaborators: room("me", "alice", "carol"),
        collaboratorDirectory: directory("alice"),
      }),
    ).toEqual(["me", "alice", "carol", UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID]);
  });

  it("default: without a current user there is no own row", () => {
    expect(
      getDefaultCollaboratorLayerOrder({
        collaborators: new Map([["alice-socket", { id: "alice" }]]),
        collaboratorDirectory: directory("alice"),
      }),
    ).toEqual(["alice", UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID]);
  });
});

describe("getCollaboratorLayerOrder (the order the rows show and the canvas uses)", () => {
  it("AC-A: before layering was ever turned on, the default order is used", () => {
    expect(getCollaboratorLayerOrder(layered(null))).toEqual([
      "me",
      "alice",
      "bob",
      UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID,
    ]);
  });

  it("AC-B: a stored order is used as it is", () => {
    const order = ["bob", UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID, "alice", "me"];
    expect(getCollaboratorLayerOrder(layered(order))).toEqual(order);
  });

  it("AC-H: a collaborator who appears for the first time is added to the bottom", () => {
    const state = {
      collaborators: room("me", "alice", "carol"),
      collaboratorDirectory: directory("alice", "carol"),
      collaboratorLayeringEnabled: true,
      collaboratorLayerOrder: ["alice", "me", UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID],
    };
    expect(getCollaboratorLayerOrder(state)).toEqual([
      "alice",
      "me",
      UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID,
      "carol",
    ]);
  });

  it("AC-H: several newcomers are added to the bottom in join order", () => {
    const state = {
      collaborators: room("me", "dave", "carol"),
      collaboratorDirectory: directory("carol", "dave"),
      collaboratorLayeringEnabled: true,
      collaboratorLayerOrder: ["me", UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID],
    };
    expect(getCollaboratorLayerOrder(state)).toEqual([
      "me",
      UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID,
      "carol",
      "dave",
    ]);
  });

  it("AC-G: a collaborator who left or is hidden keeps their place in the order", () => {
    const order = ["bob", "me", "alice", UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID];
    const state = {
      // bob left the room but is still in the directory, alice is hidden
      collaborators: room("me", "alice"),
      collaboratorDirectory: directory("alice", "bob"),
      hiddenCollaboratorIds: new Set(["alice"]),
      collaboratorLayeringEnabled: true,
      collaboratorLayerOrder: order,
    };
    expect(getCollaboratorLayerOrder(state)).toEqual(order);
  });
});

describe("moveCollaboratorLayer (↑ · ↓ and drag)", () => {
  const order = ["me", "alice", "bob", UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID];

  it("AC-A: the up arrow moves a collaborator one place up", () => {
    expect(moveCollaboratorLayer(order, "bob", 1)).toEqual([
      "me",
      "bob",
      "alice",
      UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID,
    ]);
  });

  it("AC-A: the down arrow moves a collaborator one place down", () => {
    expect(moveCollaboratorLayer(order, "alice", 2)).toEqual([
      "me",
      "bob",
      "alice",
      UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID,
    ]);
  });

  it("AC-A: the top row can't move further up", () => {
    expect(moveCollaboratorLayer(order, "me", -1)).toBe(order);
  });

  it("AC-A: the bottom row can't move further down", () => {
    expect(moveCollaboratorLayer(order, UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID, 4)).toBe(order);
  });

  it("AC-A: dragging moves a collaborator to the drop position (down)", () => {
    expect(moveCollaboratorLayer(order, "me", 3)).toEqual([
      "alice",
      "bob",
      UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID,
      "me",
    ]);
  });

  it("AC-A: dragging moves a collaborator to the drop position (up)", () => {
    expect(moveCollaboratorLayer(order, UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID, 0)).toEqual([
      UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID,
      "me",
      "alice",
      "bob",
    ]);
  });

  it("AC-A: dropping a row where it already is changes nothing", () => {
    expect(moveCollaboratorLayer(order, "alice", 1)).toBe(order);
  });

  it("AC-A: a collaborator not in the order isn't moved", () => {
    expect(moveCollaboratorLayer(order, "carol", 0)).toBe(order);
  });

  it("doesn't mutate the input order", () => {
    const input = [...order];
    moveCollaboratorLayer(input, "bob", 0);
    expect(input).toEqual(order);
  });
});
```

**Reading guide:**

- **Order lists** are written top row first: `["alice", "me", "bob", misc]` means Alice is drawn on top.
- **Element arrays** are in drawing order: the first is drawn at the bottom, the last on top.
- So with Alice on top, the expected array ends with `"alice-rect"`.
- `toBe` checks that the _same_ array came back, meaning nothing was changed or copied. `toEqual` checks the contents only.

## What these tests should cover once the code exists

I can't measure real coverage yet because the code isn't written. Below is what the tests require of each function, to check against the code in Phase 3. After Phase 3 I can run `vitest --coverage` on `ownership.ts` to confirm it.

### `orderElementsByCollaboratorLayer`

| What the code must do | Test(s) | AC |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Switch off: return the input array itself | "switch off…", "no layering state…", the first half of "off and on…" | B |
| Switch on: actually reorder (proves the "off" tests aren't passing by accident) | "(control)…" | B |
| Look up each element's rank in the order (top row = drawn last) | "higher above lower", "interleaved" | B |
| Keep the shared order inside one collaborator (stable sort) | "within one collaborator" (a3, a1, a2 keep their order) | B |
| Label takes its container's collaborator (reuses #116's `getElementCreatorId`) | "AC-D: bound label…" | D |
| Untagged elements and never-seen creators go to the miscellaneous bucket (reuses #116's `getElementVisibilityBucket`) | "miscellaneous bucket can be ordered" | A |
| A creator missing from the order goes below everyone | "AC-H: creator missing from the order…" (no directory) | H |
| Hidden and locked lists don't affect order | "AC-G: hiding or locking…" | G |
| `elementsMap` parameter: built from the elements when omitted, used when passed | Every test except AC-D omits it; AC-D passes it | D |
| No element is changed; the input array isn't mutated | "AC-E: changes no element…" | E |

### `getDefaultCollaboratorLayerOrder`

| What the code must do | Test(s) |
| --- | --- |
| You first | All six except "without a current user" |
| You're taken out of your directory position, so you aren't listed twice | "me on top even when I'm late in the directory" |
| Directory insertion order is the join order | "join order is the directory's order, not the room's" |
| Collaborators who left stay in the list | "previously seen collaborators…" |
| Live collaborators not yet in the directory go after it, with no duplicates | "a live collaborator not yet in the directory…"; the exact `toEqual` in the first test also rules out duplicates for Alice and Bob, who are both live and in the directory |
| Miscellaneous last | All six |
| No own row when there's no current user | "without a current user…" |

### `getCollaboratorLayerOrder`

| What the code must do | Test(s) | AC |
| --- | --- | --- |
| No stored order: use the default | "before layering was ever turned on…" | A |
| Stored order: use it as it is (including miscellaneous anywhere, and you at the bottom) | "a stored order is used as it is" | B |
| Anyone missing from the stored order is added at the bottom, in join order | both AC-H tests | H |
| Ids are never dropped for leaving or being hidden | "AC-G: a collaborator who left or is hidden…" | G |

### `moveCollaboratorLayer`

| What the code must do | Test(s) | AC |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Remove the row and insert it at the target position | up arrow, down arrow, drag down, drag up | A |
| A target below 0 is treated as 0, so the top row stays put | "top row can't move further up" (−1) | A |
| A target past the end is treated as the last place, so the bottom row stays put | "bottom row can't move further down" (4 of 4) | A |
| Same position: return the same array | "dropping a row where it already is" | A |
| Unknown id: return the same array | "collaborator not in the order…" | A |
| The input array isn't mutated | "doesn't mutate the input order" | n/a |

### Not covered by these tests (intentionally, or left for later phases)

- **Hiding and locking, at the action level.** "Moving doesn't change lock or visibility" (AC G), the actions themselves, and the off-then-on round trip through real AppState: Phase 4.
- **Rendering, clicks, export, binding, nothing synced, no undo entry** (AC B, C, E, F, I in the real editor): Phase 4.
- **UI** (switch, arrows, disabled states, drag, Reset): Phase 5.
- **Edge cases with no test:**

  - an empty element array;
  - a label whose container isn't in the map (it falls back to the label's own creator, as in #116);
  - collaborators with no `id` (they would be skipped);
  - a stored id that's no longer in the directory or the room (it would be kept);
  - your own row missing from the stored order (it would go to the bottom; this is my open question from Phase 2);
  - the default order when the directory is `null`. That case only runs indirectly, through the AC-H "no directory" test.

  Each is a candidate for a surviving mutant when you run Stryker. I can add any of them now if you want.

# Phase 3 checkpoint: ordering logic and state

## 1. Summary

The four pure functions are in [ownership.ts](packages/element/src/ownership.ts), and AppState has the two new local fields. All 33 Phase 2 tests pass, and the code is committed as `f1673050` on the branch (not pushed).

- **`orderElementsByCollaboratorLayer`**
  - While layering is off it returns the input array as is.
  - While on, it ranks each element by its #116 bucket, using the existing `getElementVisibilityBucket`, so labels follow their container and untagged or never-seen creators fall into the miscellaneous bucket.
  - It then does a stable sort, so each collaborator keeps the shared order.
  - A bucket that isn't in the order ranks lowest. No element is ever changed.
- **`getDefaultCollaboratorLayerOrder`**: you on top, then the keys of #116's `collaboratorDirectory` in the order they were added, then live collaborators not yet in the directory, then miscellaneous last.
- **`getCollaboratorLayerOrder`**: the stored order (or the default), with newcomers added at the bottom in join order. Ids are never removed.
- **`moveCollaboratorLayer`**: one helper for ↑, ↓ and drag. The target position is clamped to the list, and a move that changes nothing returns the same array.
- **AppState**: `collaboratorLayeringEnabled: false` and `collaboratorLayerOrder: null`. Both are set to `{ browser: false, export: false, server: false }`, next to #81's `lockedCollaboratorIds`.

**Two test fixtures changed.** No expected value changed in either:

1. **The fixture directory now includes "me".** Three tests failed at first: my rectangle was being drawn at the bottom, below Bob's. The fixture's directory left out "me", so #116's rule ("a creator not in the directory goes to miscellaneous") put my rectangle in that bucket. The real app records you in the directory when the room starts ([Collab.tsx:536](excalidraw-app/collab/Collab.tsx#L536)), so I added "me" to match. A comment in the test file explains why.
2. **Ids are set with a spread.** `newElement`/`newTextElement` don't accept `id` in their option types, so the typecheck failed. The fixtures now set the id with `{ ...newElement(...), id }`.

## Decisions log

- Initial order derived from the dropdown sections or from the shared order → **join order, you on top**, kept when the switch is turned off and on → a familiar starting order that keeps your changes.
- No Reset button → **a Reset order button** that returns to join order with you on top → matches the issue scenario.
- AC H while the switch is off → **covered by the join order** → no separate rule needed.
- Embeddables can't be layered → **accepted: skip embeddables** → they are drawn above the canvas.
- Numeric grid layer → **leave it, log as tech debt** → simple fix later.
- Export → **no new function; order inside the existing `prepareElementsForRender`** → avoid redundant export code.
- Separate join-order field (`collaboratorJoinOrder`) → **reuse #116's `collaboratorDirectory` insertion order** → use existing infrastructure.
- Your own row pinned on top → **on top only by default; you can move it after a reset** → matches the issue's resolved question.
- Reset also disabled when the order is already the default → **Reset grayed out only while layering is off**; [Layering switch][reset order] in one row directly above the rows → your layout choice.
- Previously seen order: oldest first or newest first as stored → **newest first, as #116 already loads them** → no change to #116 code.
- Binding stays on the shared order → **binding and the text-container pick use the layered order** → the arrow binds to what's drawn on top.
- Phase 2 tests → **approved; check coverage after every implementation step and go over the gaps together later** → hard to judge tests fully before the code exists.

## Tech debt

**Introduced:**

- The default order depends on `collaboratorDirectory` keeping keys in insertion order. That is how `Map` works, but nothing in the code states it as a rule.

**Encountered:**

- `exportToCanvas` rewrites element indices through `syncInvalidIndices`.
- The numeric grid layer assumes drawing order matches index order.
- Embeddables are drawn above the canvas and can't be layered.
- The renderer's cache key must list every local setting that affects ordering.
- `yarn prettier <files>` formats the whole repo.
- The directory is saved sorted by `lastSeen`, so previously seen collaborators load newest first.
- **New:** `newElement`/`newTextElement` accept `id` at runtime, but their option types don't.
- **New:** 3 SVG font snapshots in `scene/__snapshots__/export.test.ts.snap` fail on the untouched branch on this machine.

Waiting for "Approved" before Phase 4.

```text
/**
 * Issue #81 — per-collaborator lock (visible but non-interactive).
 *
 * State-logic tests for Criteria A, B, C, G, H and the unknown /
 * miscellaneous bucket. Every expected value below is derived from the
 * acceptance criteria in #81, not from running the implementation.
 */
import { KEYS } from "@excalidraw/common";
import { CREATOR_ID_KEY, UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID } from "@excalidraw/element";
import { newElementWith } from "@excalidraw/element";
import { assert } from "vitest";

import type {
  ExcalidrawArrowElement,
  ExcalidrawElement,
} from "@excalidraw/element/types";

import {
  clearAppStateForDatabase,
  clearAppStateForLocalStorage,
  cleanAppStateForExport,
} from "../appState";
import { restoreAppState } from "../data/restore";
import { Excalidraw } from "../index";
import {
  getBulkLockAvailability,
  getCollaboratorVisibilityRows,
} from "../scene/visibility";

import { API } from "./helpers/api";
import { Keyboard, Pointer, UI } from "./helpers/ui";
import {
  act,
  fireEvent,
  mockBoundingClientRect,
  render,
  restoreOriginalGetBoundingClientRect,
  unmountComponent,
  waitFor,
} from "./test-utils";

import type { ActionName } from "../actions/types";
import type { CollaboratorVisibilityRow } from "../scene/visibility";
import type { AppState } from "../types";

unmountComponent();

const h = window.h;

const stamp = <T extends ExcalidrawElement>(element: T, creatorId: string) =>
  newElementWith(element as ExcalidrawElement, {
    customData: { [CREATOR_ID_KEY]: creatorId },
  }) as T;

const createRect = (id: string, x: number) =>
  API.createElement({ type: "rectangle", id, x, y: 0, width: 10 });

/**
 * Runs a registered action by name. Looking actions up in the registry
 * (instead of importing them) makes a not-yet-implemented action fail as a
 * readable assertion rather than as a broken import.
 */
const execute = (name: string, value?: string) => {
  const action = h.app.actionManager.actions[name as ActionName];
  assert.isDefined(action, `action "${name}" should be registered`);
  act(() => {
    h.app.actionManager.executeAction(action, "ui", value as any);
  });
};

const lockedIds = () => {
  expect(h.state.lockedCollaboratorIds).toBeInstanceOf(Set);
  return [...h.state.lockedCollaboratorIds].sort();
};

const hiddenIds = () => [...h.state.hiddenCollaboratorIds].sort();

/** every row the dropdown lists, keyed by bucket id */
const getRows = () => {
  const rows = getCollaboratorVisibilityRows(h.elements, h.state);
  return new Map(
    [...rows.inRoom, ...rows.previouslySeen, rows.miscellaneous].map((row) => [
      row.id,
      row,
    ]),
  );
};

const getRow = (id: string) => {
  const row = getRows().get(id);
  assert.isDefined(row, `row "${id}" should be listed`);
  return row!;
};

// Session used by every test:
// - me    : this client (in the room)
// - alice : in the room
// - carol : previously seen (in the directory, no longer live)
// - misc  : untagged elements + "dave", a creator this client never saw
const collaborators = new Map([
  ["my-socket", { id: "me", username: "Me", isCurrentUser: true }],
  ["alice-socket", { id: "alice", username: "Alice" }],
]) as unknown as AppState["collaborators"];

const collaboratorDirectory = new Map([
  ["me", { username: "Me", lastSeen: 3 }],
  ["alice", { username: "Alice", lastSeen: 3 }],
  ["carol", { username: "Carol", lastSeen: 2 }],
]);

/** the buckets the dropdown lists for this session, other than me */
const OTHERS = ["alice", "carol", UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID].sort();

beforeEach(async () => {
  await render(<Excalidraw handleKeyboardGlobally={true} />);
  API.setElements([
    stamp(createRect("me-rect", 0), "me"),
    stamp(createRect("alice-rect", 20), "alice"),
    stamp(createRect("carol-rect", 40), "carol"),
    stamp(createRect("dave-rect", 60), "dave"),
    createRect("legacy-rect", 80),
  ]);
  act(() => {
    h.app.updateScene({ collaborators });
    API.setAppState({ collaboratorDirectory });
  });
});

describe("collaborator lock — Criteria A (per-collaborator toggle)", () => {
  it("AC-A: nobody is locked by default", () => {
    expect(lockedIds()).toEqual([]);
    for (const id of ["me", "alice", "carol", UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID]) {
      expect(getRow(id).isLocked).toBe(false);
    }
  });

  it("AC-A: toggling a collaborator's lock locks them, toggling again unlocks them", () => {
    execute("toggleCollaboratorLock", "alice");
    expect(lockedIds()).toEqual(["alice"]);
    expect(getRow("alice").isLocked).toBe(true);
```

```text
const getSentUpdates = () =>
  mocks.emitted
    .filter(([event]) => event === WS_EVENTS.SERVER)
    .map(([, , buffer]) => JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(buffer)))
    .filter((message) => message.type === WS_SUBTYPES.UPDATE);

/** simulates a message from another client arriving through the room */
const deliver = async (
  message: SocketUpdateDataSource[keyof SocketUpdateDataSource],
) => {
  await mocks.handlers.get("client-broadcast")!(
    new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(message)),
    new Uint8Array(12),
  );

  await mocks.handlers.get("first-in-room")!();

};

  beforeEach(async () => {
    mocks.handlers.clear();
    mocks.emitted.length = 0;
    localStorage.clear();
    sessionStorage.clear();
    // a previous test's room link would make the app auto-join that room
    window.history.replaceState({}, "", window.location.origin);
    await render(<ExcalidrawApp />);
    await startNewRoom();
    await receivePeerElement();
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    vi.restoreAllMocks();
  });

  /** a local edit (adds an element), synced to the room */
  const addLocalElement = (id: string) => {
    API.updateScene({
      elements: syncInvalidIndices([
        ...h.app.scene.getElementsIncludingDeleted(),
        API.createElement({ id }),
      ]),
      captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.IMMEDIATELY,
    });
    sync();
  };

  /**
   * ids of the elements in each scene update sent after `from` (sending is
   * async: messages are encrypted first, so callers wait for them)
   */
  const getSentElementIdsSince = (from: number) =>
    getSentUpdates()
      .slice(from)
      .map((message) =>
        message.payload.elements.map((el: ExcalidrawElement) => el.id),
      );

  it("(control) a local edit is sent to the room", async () => {
    const sentBefore = getSentUpdates().length;

    addLocalElement("mine");

    await waitFor(() =>
      expect(getSentElementIdsSince(sentBefore)[0]).toContain("mine"),
    );
  });

  it("AC-F: locking and unlocking sends nothing new to other collaborators", async () => {
    const sentBefore = getSentUpdates().length;
    const emittedBefore = mocks.emitted.length;

    execute("toggleCollaboratorLock", UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID);
    execute("toggleCollaboratorLock", "alice");
    execute("lockAllCollaborators");
    execute("unlockAllCollaborators");
    // what onChange would do after each state change
    sync();

    // messages go out in order: if the first update sent after locking is
    // this marker edit, locking itself sent nothing
    addLocalElement("marker");
    await waitFor(() =>
      expect(getSentUpdates().length).toBeGreaterThan(sentBefore),
    );

    expect(getSentElementIdsSince(sentBefore)[0]).toContain("marker");
    // and nothing else (e.g. volatile messages) was emitted before it
    expect(
      mocks.emitted
        .slice(emittedBefore)
        .findIndex(([event]) => event === WS_EVENTS.SERVER),
    ).toBe(0);
  });

  it("AC-F: locking and unlocking change no element versions", () => {
    const before = getVersions();

    execute("lockAllCollaborators");
    execute("unlockAllCollaborators");
    sync();

    expect(getVersions()).toEqual(before);
  });

  it("AC-F: a peer's edit to a locked collaborator's element still arrives", async () => {
    execute("lockAllCollaborators");

    await deliver({
      type: WS_SUBTYPES.UPDATE,
      payload: {
        elements: syncInvalidIndices([
          newElementWith(getElement("theirs"), { x: 500 }),
        ]),
      },
    });

    await waitFor(() => expect(getElement("theirs").x).toBe(500));
  });
});
```

```typescript
/**
 * Issue #82 — local collaborator layering, at the editor level: actions and
 * state, drawing, clicking, binding and export. Every expected value below
 * is derived from the acceptance criteria in #82 and the decisions approved
 * on it, not from running the implementation:
 *
 * - A: rows move up/down one place or to a drop position; controls only
 *   while the switch is on
 * - B: off → the shared order; on → a higher row's elements are drawn above
 *   every element of a lower one (shared order within a row); the order is
 *   kept across switching off and on
 * - C: clicking selects what's drawn on top; a locked top element lets the
 *   click through (#81 D)
 * - D: labels drawn with their container; frame children still clipped
 * - E: no element changes; Bring forward still works, within the layer
 * - F: local, not in history, reset on reload
 * - G: hiding/locking and moving don't affect each other
 * - H: newcomers go to the bottom
 * - I: PNG/SVG export follows the local order
 * - default/reset order (decision): me on top, then join order (#116's
 *   collaborator directory order), miscellaneous last
 * - binding (decision): arrows bind to the shape on top in my layering
 */
import { CREATOR_ID_KEY, UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID } from "@excalidraw/element";
import { getCollaboratorLayerOrder, newElementWith } from "@excalidraw/element";
import { assert } from "vitest";

import type {
  ExcalidrawArrowElement,
  ExcalidrawElement,
  NonDeletedExcalidrawElement,
} from "@excalidraw/element/types";

import {
  clearAppStateForDatabase,
  clearAppStateForLocalStorage,
  cleanAppStateForExport,
} from "../appState";
import * as Clipboard from "../clipboard";
import { exportCanvas } from "../data";
import { restoreAppState } from "../data/restore";
import { Excalidraw } from "../index";
import * as StaticScene from "../renderer/staticScene";
import { exportToCanvas } from "../scene/export";

import { API } from "./helpers/api";
import { Pointer, UI } from "./helpers/ui";
import { act, render, unmountComponent } from "./test-utils";

import type { ActionName } from "../actions/types";
import type { ExportedElements } from "../data";
import type { AppState } from "../types";

unmountComponent();

const h = window.h;
const mouse = new Pointer("mouse");

const stamp = <T extends ExcalidrawElement>(element: T, creatorId: string) =>
  newElementWith(element as ExcalidrawElement, {
    customData: { [CREATOR_ID_KEY]: creatorId },
  }) as T;

/** solid fill so clicking the interior counts as a hit */
const createSolidRect = (
  id: string,
  extra: Partial<{
    x: number;
    y: number;
    width: number;
    strokeColor: string;
    frameId: string;
    boundElements: { type: "text"; id: string }[];
  }> = {},
) =>
  API.createElement({
    type: "rectangle",
    id,
    x: extra.x ?? 0,
    y: extra.y ?? 0,
    width: extra.width ?? 100,
    height: 100,
    backgroundColor: "red",
    fillStyle: "solid",
    strokeColor: extra.strokeColor,
    frameId: extra.frameId ?? null,
    boundElements: extra.boundElements ?? null,
  });

/**
 * Runs a registered action by name (a missing action fails as a readable
 * assertion rather than a broken import, as in #81's tests)
 */
const execute = (name: string, value?: unknown) => {
  const action = h.app.actionManager.actions[name as ActionName];
  assert.isDefined(action, `action "${name}" should be registered`);
  act(() => {
    h.app.actionManager.executeAction(action, "ui", value as any);
  });
};

const toggleLayering = () => execute("toggleCollaboratorLayering");
const move = (id: string, toIndex: number) =>
  execute("moveCollaboratorLayer", { id, toIndex });

/** the order the rows show and the canvas uses (top row first) */
const layerOrder = () => getCollaboratorLayerOrder(h.state);

/** ids of the elements App draws, in drawing order (last = on top) */
const drawnIds = () => h.app.visibleElements.map((el) => el.id);

const getElement = (id: string) => h.elements.find((el) => el.id === id)!;

const getSelectedIds = () => API.getSelectedElements().map((el) => el.id);

/** what AC-E says must not change */
const getShared = () =>
  h.elements.map(({ id, index, version, versionNonce }) => ({
    id,
    index,
    version,
    versionNonce,
  }));

// Session used by every test:
// - me    : this client (recorded first in the directory, like Collab does)
// - alice : in the room, joined before bob
// - bob   : in the room
const collaborators = new Map([
  ["my-socket", { id: "me", username: "Me", isCurrentUser: true }],
  ["alice-socket", { id: "alice", username: "Alice" }],
  ["bob-socket", { id: "bob", username: "Bob" }],
]) as unknown as AppState["collaborators"];

const collaboratorDirectory = new Map([
  ["me", { username: "Me", lastSeen: 1 }],
  ["alice", { username: "Alice", lastSeen: 1 }],
  ["bob", { username: "Bob", lastSeen: 1 }],
]);

/** the default (and reset) order for this session */
const DEFAULT_ORDER = ["me", "alice", "bob", UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID];

beforeEach(async () => {
  await render(<Excalidraw handleKeyboardGlobally={true} />);
  // alice's shape under bob's, at the same position (bob's on top in the
  // shared order)
  API.setElements([
    stamp(createSolidRect("alice-under"), "alice"),
    stamp(createSolidRect("bob-over"), "bob"),
  ]);
  act(() => {
    h.app.updateScene({ collaborators });
    // jsdom's viewport is 0×0: give the canvas a size so elements are drawn
    API.setAppState({ collaboratorDirectory, width: 1000, height: 1000 });
  });
});

afterEach(() => {
  mouse.reset();
});

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// actions and state
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

describe("collaborator layering — switch and order (A, B, reset)", () => {
  it("AC-A: the Layering switch is off by default", () => {
    expect(h.state.collaboratorLayeringEnabled).toBe(false);
    expect(h.state.collaboratorLayerOrder).toBe(null);
  });

  it("default order: the first switch-on puts me on top, then join order, miscellaneous last", () => {
    toggleLayering();
    expect(h.state.collaboratorLayeringEnabled).toBe(true);
    expect(h.state.collaboratorLayerOrder).toEqual(DEFAULT_ORDER);
  });

  it("AC-A: moving a row one place up", () => {
    toggleLayering();
    move("bob", 1);
    expect(layerOrder()).toEqual(["me", "bob", "alice", UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID]);
  });

  it("AC-A: moving a row to a drop position", () => {
    toggleLayering();
    move(UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID, 0);
    expect(layerOrder()).toEqual([UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID, "me", "alice", "bob"]);
  });

  it("AC-A: rows can't be moved while the switch is off (controls hidden)", () => {
    move("bob", 0);
    expect(h.state.collaboratorLayerOrder).toBe(null);
  });

  it("AC-B: turning the switch off and on again keeps the chosen order", () => {
    toggleLayering();
    move("bob", 0);
    toggleLayering();
    expect(h.state.collaboratorLayeringEnabled).toBe(false);
    toggleLayering();
    expect(layerOrder()).toEqual(["bob", "me", "alice", UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID]);
  });

  it("reset: returns to the default order with me on top", () => {
    toggleLayering();
    move("me", 3);
    move("bob", 0);
    execute("resetCollaboratorLayerOrder");
    expect(layerOrder()).toEqual(DEFAULT_ORDER);
  });

  it("reset: does nothing while the switch is off (grayed out)", () => {
    toggleLayering();
    move("bob", 0);
    toggleLayering();
    execute("resetCollaboratorLayerOrder");
    expect(h.state.collaboratorLayerOrder).toEqual([
      "bob",
      "me",
      "alice",
      UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID,
    ]);
  });

  it("reset: me can be moved down again after a reset", () => {
    toggleLayering();
    execute("resetCollaboratorLayerOrder");
    move("me", 1);
    expect(layerOrder()).toEqual(["alice", "me", "bob", UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID]);
  });
});

describe("collaborator layering — Criteria G (visibility and locking)", () => {
  it("AC-G: hiding or locking a collaborator doesn't change their place", () => {
    toggleLayering();
    move("bob", 0);
    const order = layerOrder();

    execute("toggleCollaboratorVisibility", "alice");
    execute("toggleCollaboratorLock", "bob");

    expect(layerOrder()).toEqual(order);
  });

  it("AC-G: moving a collaborator doesn't change their lock or visibility", () => {
    execute("toggleCollaboratorVisibility", "alice");
    execute("toggleCollaboratorLock", "bob");
    const hidden = [...h.state.hiddenCollaboratorIds].sort();
    const locked = [...h.state.lockedCollaboratorIds].sort();

    toggleLayering();
    move("alice", 0);
    move("bob", 3);

    expect([...h.state.hiddenCollaboratorIds].sort()).toEqual(hidden);
    expect([...h.state.lockedCollaboratorIds].sort()).toEqual(locked);
  });

  it("AC-G: a hidden collaborator is drawn in their place when shown again", () => {
    toggleLayering();
    move("alice", 0); // alice above bob

    execute("toggleCollaboratorVisibility", "alice");
    expect(drawnIds()).toEqual(["bob-over"]);

    execute("toggleCollaboratorVisibility", "alice");
    expect(drawnIds()).toEqual(["bob-over", "alice-under"]);
  });
});

describe("collaborator layering — Criteria H (new collaborators)", () => {
  it("AC-H: a collaborator who joins while layering is on is added to the bottom", () => {
    toggleLayering();
    act(() => {
      h.app.updateScene({
        collaborators: new Map([
          ...collaborators,
          ["carol-socket", { id: "carol", username: "Carol" }],
        ]) as unknown as AppState["collaborators"],
      });
      API.setAppState({
        collaboratorDirectory: new Map([
          ...collaboratorDirectory,
          ["carol", { username: "Carol", lastSeen: 2 }],
        ]),
      });
    });

    expect(layerOrder()).toEqual([...DEFAULT_ORDER, "carol"]);
  });

  it("AC-H: the newcomer's drawings are drawn below everyone", () => {
    toggleLayering();
    act(() => {
      h.app.updateScene({
        collaborators: new Map([
          ...collaborators,
          ["carol-socket", { id: "carol", username: "Carol" }],
        ]) as unknown as AppState["collaborators"],
      });
      API.setAppState({
        collaboratorDirectory: new Map([
          ...collaboratorDirectory,
          ["carol", { username: "Carol", lastSeen: 2 }],
        ]),
      });
    });
    // carol draws on top of everything in the shared order
    API.setElements([
      ...h.elements,
      stamp(createSolidRect("carol-top"), "carol"),
    ]);

    expect(drawnIds()[0]).toBe("carol-top");
  });
});

describe("collaborator layering — Criteria F (local and non-persistent)", () => {
  it("AC-F: the switch, moves and reset add no undo history entries", () => {
    const undoStackSize = API.getUndoStack().length;

    toggleLayering();
    move("bob", 0);
    execute("resetCollaboratorLayerOrder");
    toggleLayering();

    expect(API.getUndoStack().length).toBe(undoStackSize);
  });

  it("AC-F: the layer order is not saved to local storage", () => {
    toggleLayering();
    const saved = clearAppStateForLocalStorage(h.state);
    expect(saved).not.toHaveProperty("collaboratorLayeringEnabled");
    expect(saved).not.toHaveProperty("collaboratorLayerOrder");
  });

  it("AC-F: the layer order is not included in exported files", () => {
    toggleLayering();
    const exported = cleanAppStateForExport(h.state);
    expect(exported).not.toHaveProperty("collaboratorLayeringEnabled");
    expect(exported).not.toHaveProperty("collaboratorLayerOrder");
  });

  it("AC-F: the layer order is not sent to the server / other collaborators", () => {
    toggleLayering();
    const sent = clearAppStateForDatabase(h.state);
    expect(sent).not.toHaveProperty("collaboratorLayeringEnabled");
    expect(sent).not.toHaveProperty("collaboratorLayerOrder");
  });

  it("AC-F: the layer order resets when the page reloads", () => {
    toggleLayering();
    move("bob", 0);

    // a reload restores app state from what was saved locally
    const restored = restoreAppState(
      clearAppStateForLocalStorage(h.state),
      null,
    );

    expect(restored.collaboratorLayeringEnabled).toBe(false);
    expect(restored.collaboratorLayerOrder).toBe(null);
  });
});

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// drawing
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

describe("collaborator layering — Criteria B (drawing)", () => {
  it("AC-B: with the switch off the canvas uses the shared order, even with a chosen order", () => {
    toggleLayering();
    move("alice", 0);
    toggleLayering();
    expect(drawnIds()).toEqual(["alice-under", "bob-over"]);
  });

  it("AC-B: (control) the same setup with the switch on is drawn differently", () => {
    toggleLayering();
    move("alice", 0);
    expect(drawnIds()).not.toEqual(["alice-under", "bob-over"]);
  });

  it("AC-B: a higher collaborator's elements are drawn above a lower one's", () => {
    toggleLayering();
    move("alice", 0);
    expect(drawnIds()).toEqual(["bob-over", "alice-under"]);
  });

  it("AC-B: every element of a higher collaborator is above every element of a lower one; each keeps the shared order", () => {
    API.setElements([
      stamp(createSolidRect("a1"), "alice"),
      stamp(createSolidRect("b1"), "bob"),
      stamp(createSolidRect("a2"), "alice"),
      stamp(createSolidRect("b2"), "bob"),
    ]);
    toggleLayering();
    move("alice", 0);
    expect(drawnIds()).toEqual(["b1", "b2", "a1", "a2"]);
  });

  it("AC-E: my own Bring forward changes the shared order and takes effect within my layer", () => {
    // shared: m1 < m2 < alice's a1; alice on top of me in my layering
    API.setElements([
      stamp(createSolidRect("m1"), "me"),
      stamp(createSolidRect("m2"), "me"),
      stamp(createSolidRect("a1"), "alice"),
    ]);
    toggleLayering();
    move("alice", 0);
    expect(drawnIds()).toEqual(["m1", "m2", "a1"]);

    API.setSelectedElements([getElement("m1")]);
    execute("bringForward");

    // shared order changed as before (m1 now above m2)…
    expect(getElement("m1").index! > getElement("m2").index!).toBe(true);
    // …and on my screen only within my layer (still below alice)
    expect(drawnIds()).toEqual(["m2", "m1", "a1"]);
  });
});

describe("collaborator layering — Criteria D (attached elements)", () => {
  it("AC-D: a label is drawn directly with its container, even when the label's creator is higher", () => {
    API.setElements([
      stamp(
        createSolidRect("container", {
          boundElements: [{ type: "text", id: "label" }],
        }),
        "alice",
      ),
      stamp(createSolidRect("bob-shape"), "bob"),
      stamp(
        API.createElement({
          type: "text",
          id: "label",
          text: "label",
          containerId: "container",
        }),
        "bob",
      ),
    ]);
    toggleLayering(); // default: alice above bob
    move("bob", 0); // bob on top

    expect(drawnIds()).toEqual(["container", "label", "bob-shape"]);
  });

  describe("frame children are still clipped", () => {
    // alice's frame (x 0–100) with bob's child sticking out (x 50–150)
    beforeEach(() => {
      API.setElements([
        stamp(createSolidRect("child", { x: 50, frameId: "frame" }), "bob"),
        stamp(
          API.createElement({
            type: "frame",
            id: "frame",
            x: 0,
            y: 0,
            width: 100,
            height: 100,
          }),
          "alice",
        ),
      ]);
      toggleLayering();
      move("bob", 0); // bob above alice: child drawn after its frame
    });

    it("AC-D: (control) layering on does reorder the frame and its child", () => {
      expect(drawnIds()).toEqual(["frame", "child"]);
    });

    it("AC-D: the child keeps its frame, so it's still clipped to it", () => {
      expect(getElement("child").frameId).toBe("frame");
    });

    it("AC-D: clicking the child inside the frame selects it", () => {
      mouse.clickAt(75, 50);
      expect(getSelectedIds()).toEqual(["child"]);
    });

    it("AC-D: clicking the child's clipped part outside the frame selects nothing", () => {
      mouse.clickAt(125, 50);
      expect(getSelectedIds()).toEqual([]);
    });
  });
});

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// clicking and binding
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

describe("collaborator layering — Criteria C (what I click is what I see)", () => {
  it("AC-C: (control) with the switch off, clicking the overlap selects the shared top element", () => {
    mouse.clickAt(50, 50);
    expect(getSelectedIds()).toEqual(["bob-over"]);
  });

  it("AC-C: with the switch on, clicking the overlap selects the element drawn on top", () => {
    toggleLayering();
    move("alice", 0);
    mouse.clickAt(50, 50);
    expect(getSelectedIds()).toEqual(["alice-under"]);
  });

  it("AC-C: a locked top element lets the click through to the element underneath", () => {
    toggleLayering();
    move("alice", 0);
    execute("toggleCollaboratorLock", "alice");
    mouse.clickAt(50, 50);
    expect(getSelectedIds()).toEqual(["bob-over"]);
  });

  describe("arrow binding (decision: binds to the shape on top)", () => {
    const getArrow = () =>
      h.elements.find(
        (el): el is ExcalidrawArrowElement =>
          el.type === "arrow" && !el.isDeleted,
      )!;

    const drawArrowIntoOverlap = () => {
      UI.clickTool("arrow");
      mouse.downAt(300, 50);
      mouse.moveTo(200, 50);
      mouse.moveTo(50, 50);
      mouse.upAt(50, 50);
    };

    it("(control) with the switch off, the arrow binds to the shared top shape", () => {
      drawArrowIntoOverlap();
      expect(getArrow().endBinding?.elementId).toBe("bob-over");
    });

    it("with the switch on, the arrow binds to the shape drawn on top", () => {
      toggleLayering();
      move("alice", 0);
      drawArrowIntoOverlap();
      expect(getArrow().endBinding?.elementId).toBe("alice-under");
    });
  });
});

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// shared state and export
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

describe("collaborator layering — Criteria E (shared-state integrity, editor side)", () => {
  it("AC-E: the switch, moves and reset change no element index or version", () => {
    const before = getShared();

    toggleLayering();
    move("alice", 0);
    execute("resetCollaboratorLayerOrder");
    toggleLayering();

    expect(getShared()).toEqual(before);
  });

  it("AC-E: the scene keeps the shared order while layering is on", () => {
    toggleLayering();
    move("alice", 0);
    expect(h.elements.map((el) => el.id)).toEqual(["alice-under", "bob-over"]);
  });
});

describe("collaborator layering — Criteria I (export)", () => {
  // distinct stroke colors to find each shape in the SVG
  const ALICE = "#aa0000";
  const BOB = "#0000bb";

  beforeEach(() => {
    API.setElements([
      stamp(createSolidRect("alice-under", { strokeColor: ALICE }), "alice"),
      stamp(createSolidRect("bob-over", { strokeColor: BOB }), "bob"),
    ]);
  });

  const exportElements = () =>
    h.elements.filter((el) => !el.isDeleted) as unknown as ExportedElements;

  /** SVG text as the "copy as SVG" export produces it */
  const exportSvg = async () => {
    const copy = vi
      .spyOn(Clipboard, "copyTextToSystemClipboard")
      .mockResolvedValue(undefined);
    await exportCanvas("clipboard-svg", exportElements(), h.state, h.files, {
      exportBackground: false,
      viewBackgroundColor: "#ffffff",
      exportingFrame: null,
    });
    const svg = copy.mock.calls[0][0] as string;
    copy.mockRestore();
    return svg;
  };

  /** ids in the order the PNG (canvas) export draws them */
  const exportPngDrawOrder = async () => {
    const renderSpy = vi.spyOn(StaticScene, "renderStaticScene");
    await exportToCanvas(
      exportElements() as readonly NonDeletedExcalidrawElement[],
      h.state,
      h.files,
      {
        exportBackground: false,
        viewBackgroundColor: "#ffffff",
      },
    );
    const drawn = renderSpy.mock.calls[0][0].visibleElements.map((el) => el.id);
    renderSpy.mockRestore();
    return drawn;
  };

  it("AC-I: (control) with the switch off, the SVG export uses the shared order", async () => {
    const svg = await exportSvg();
    expect(svg.indexOf(ALICE)).toBeLessThan(svg.indexOf(BOB));
  });

  it("AC-I: the SVG export follows my layer order", async () => {
    toggleLayering();
    move("alice", 0);
    const svg = await exportSvg();
    expect(svg.indexOf(BOB)).toBeLessThan(svg.indexOf(ALICE));
  });

  it("AC-I: (control) with the switch off, the PNG export uses the shared order", async () => {
    expect(await exportPngDrawOrder()).toEqual(["alice-under", "bob-over"]);
  });

  it("AC-I: the PNG export follows my layer order", async () => {
    toggleLayering();
    move("alice", 0);
    expect(await exportPngDrawOrder()).toEqual(["bob-over", "alice-under"]);
  });

  it("AC-E: exporting with layering on changes no element index or version", async () => {
    toggleLayering();
    move("alice", 0);
    const before = getShared();

    await exportPngDrawOrder();
    await exportSvg();

    expect(getShared()).toEqual(before);
  });
});
```

```typescript
/**
 * Issue #82 — Criteria E (shared-state integrity) driven through the real
 * Collab/Portal classes. The socket records everything this client sends;
 * encryption is a passthrough. Setup mirrors collabLock.test.tsx (#81).
 *
 * AC-E: "Reordering changes no element (`index` and `version` stay the
 * same) and sends nothing new to other collaborators. Other collaborators
 * see the shared order."
 */
import { CaptureUpdateAction } from "@excalidraw/excalidraw";
import { API } from "@excalidraw/excalidraw/tests/helpers/api";
import { act, render, waitFor } from "@excalidraw/excalidraw/tests/test-utils";
import {
  CREATOR_ID_KEY,
  UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID,
  newElementWith,
  syncInvalidIndices,
} from "@excalidraw/element";
import { assert, vi } from "vitest";

import type { ActionName } from "@excalidraw/excalidraw/actions/types";
import type { ExcalidrawElement } from "@excalidraw/element/types";

import { WS_EVENTS, WS_SUBTYPES } from "../app_constants";
import ExcalidrawApp from "../App";

import type { SocketUpdateDataSource } from "../data";

const { h } = window;

const mocks = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  handlers: new Map<string, (...args: any[]) => any>(),
  emitted: [] as any[][],
}));

vi.mock("socket.io-client", () => ({
  default: () => ({
    id: "my-socket",
    on: (event: string, handler: (...args: any[]) => any) => {
      mocks.handlers.set(event, handler);
    },
    once: () => {},
    off: () => {},
    emit: (...args: any[]) => {
      mocks.emitted.push(args);
    },
    close: () => {},
  }),
}));

// all exports mocked explicitly (spreading `importOriginal()` deadlocks the
// app's module initialization, see collabVisibility.test.tsx)
vi.mock("@excalidraw/excalidraw/data/encryption", () => ({
  IV_LENGTH_BYTES: 12,
  createIV: () => new Uint8Array(12),
  getCryptoKey: async () => ({}),
  generateEncryptionKey: async () => "test-room-key",
  encryptData: async (_key: string, data: Uint8Array) => ({
    encryptedBuffer: data,
    iv: new Uint8Array(12),
  }),
  decryptData: async (_iv: Uint8Array, data: ArrayBuffer) => data,
}));

vi.mock("../data/firebase", () => ({
  loadFromFirebase: async () => null,
  saveToFirebase: async () => null,
  isSavedToFirebase: () => true,
  loadFilesFromFirebase: async () => ({ loadedFiles: [], erroredFiles: [] }),
  saveFilesToFirebase: async () => ({
    savedFiles: new Map(),
    erroredFiles: new Map(),
  }),
}));

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

const stamp = <T extends ExcalidrawElement>(element: T, creatorId: string) =>
  newElementWith(element as ExcalidrawElement, {
    customData: { [CREATOR_ID_KEY]: creatorId },
  }) as T;

/** scene updates this client sent to the room (decoded) */
const getSentUpdates = () =>
  mocks.emitted
    .filter(([event]) => event === WS_EVENTS.SERVER)
    .map(([, , buffer]) => JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(buffer)))
    .filter((message) => message.type === WS_SUBTYPES.UPDATE);

/** simulates a message from another client arriving through the room */
const deliver = async (
  message: SocketUpdateDataSource[keyof SocketUpdateDataSource],
) => {
  await mocks.handlers.get("client-broadcast")!(
    new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(message)),
    new Uint8Array(12),
  );
};

/** local changes reach Collab through onChange → syncElements */
const sync = () => {
  act(() => {
    window.collab.syncElements(h.app.scene.getElementsIncludingDeleted());
  });
};

/** start a new room and finish initialization (we're alone in it) */
const startNewRoom = async () => {
  act(() => {
    window.collab.startCollaboration(null);
  });
  await waitFor(() => expect(mocks.handlers.has("first-in-room")).toBe(true));
  await mocks.handlers.get("first-in-room")!();
  await waitFor(() =>
    expect(window.collab.portal.socketInitialized).toBe(true),
  );
};

const execute = (name: string, value?: unknown) => {
  const action = h.app.actionManager.actions[name as ActionName];
  assert.isDefined(action, `action "${name}" should be registered`);
  act(() => {
    h.app.actionManager.executeAction(action, "ui", value as any);
  });
};

/** what AC-E says must not change */
const getShared = () =>
  h.elements.map(({ id, index, version, versionNonce }) => ({
    id,
    index,
    version,
    versionNonce,
  }));

const getElement = (id: string) => h.elements.find((el) => el.id === id)!;

/** a peer's element arrives in the room, on top of the shared order */
const receivePeerElement = async (id: string) => {
  await deliver({
    type: WS_SUBTYPES.UPDATE,
    payload: {
      elements: syncInvalidIndices([
        ...h.app.scene.getElementsIncludingDeleted(),
        stamp(API.createElement({ id, x: 0 }), "alice"),
      ]),
    },
  });
  await waitFor(() => expect(getElement(id)).toBeDefined());
};

/** layering on, with the miscellaneous bucket (alice's, unseen) on top */
const reorderLocally = () => {
  execute("toggleCollaboratorLayering");
  execute("moveCollaboratorLayer", { id: UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID, toIndex: 0 });
};

describe("collaborator layering (collaboration) — Criteria E", () => {
  beforeEach(async () => {
    mocks.handlers.clear();
    mocks.emitted.length = 0;
    localStorage.clear();
    sessionStorage.clear();
    // a previous test's room link would make the app auto-join that room
    window.history.replaceState({}, "", window.location.origin);
    await render(<ExcalidrawApp />);
    await startNewRoom();
    await receivePeerElement("theirs");
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    vi.restoreAllMocks();
  });

  /** a local edit (adds an element), synced to the room */
  const addLocalElement = (id: string) => {
    API.updateScene({
      elements: syncInvalidIndices([
        ...h.app.scene.getElementsIncludingDeleted(),
        API.createElement({ id }),
      ]),
      captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.IMMEDIATELY,
    });
    sync();
  };

  const getSentElementIdsSince = (from: number) =>
    getSentUpdates()
      .slice(from)
      .map((message) =>
        message.payload.elements.map((el: ExcalidrawElement) => el.id),
      );

  it("(control) a local edit is sent to the room", async () => {
    const sentBefore = getSentUpdates().length;

    addLocalElement("mine");

    await waitFor(() =>
      expect(getSentElementIdsSince(sentBefore)[0]).toContain("mine"),
    );
  });

  it("AC-E: switching layering, reordering and resetting send nothing new to other collaborators", async () => {
    const sentBefore = getSentUpdates().length;
    const emittedBefore = mocks.emitted.length;

    reorderLocally();
    execute("resetCollaboratorLayerOrder");
    execute("toggleCollaboratorLayering");
    // what onChange would do after each state change
    sync();

    // messages go out in order: if the first update sent after reordering
    // is this marker edit, reordering itself sent nothing
    addLocalElement("marker");
    await waitFor(() =>
      expect(getSentUpdates().length).toBeGreaterThan(sentBefore),
    );

    expect(getSentElementIdsSince(sentBefore)[0]).toContain("marker");
    // and nothing else (e.g. volatile messages) was emitted before it
    expect(
      mocks.emitted
        .slice(emittedBefore)
        .findIndex(([event]) => event === WS_EVENTS.SERVER),
    ).toBe(0);
  });

  it("AC-E: reordering changes no element index or version", () => {
    const before = getShared();

    reorderLocally();
    sync();

    expect(getShared()).toEqual(before);
  });

  it("AC-E: a local edit while reordered sends the shared indices", async () => {
    reorderLocally();
    const sharedIndex = getElement("theirs").index;
    const sentBefore = getSentUpdates().length;

    addLocalElement("marker");
    await waitFor(() =>
      expect(getSentUpdates().length).toBeGreaterThan(sentBefore),
    );

    const sentTheirs = getSentUpdates()
      .slice(sentBefore)
      .flatMap((message) => message.payload.elements)
      .find((el: ExcalidrawElement) => el.id === "theirs");
    // either not resent at all, or resent unchanged
    expect(sentTheirs?.index ?? sharedIndex).toBe(sharedIndex);
  });

  it("AC-E: a peer's update still arrives, and my scene keeps the shared order", async () => {
    reorderLocally();

    await receivePeerElement("theirs-2");

    const indices = h.elements.map((el) => el.index!);
    expect(indices).toEqual([...indices].sort());
    expect(h.elements.map((el) => el.id)).toEqual(["theirs", "theirs-2"]);
  });
});
```

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# usage: changed_cov.sh <lcov.info> <base-commit> <file>...
# prints, per file, coverage of the lines added/changed since <base-commit>
LCOV="$1"; BASE="$2"; shift 2
NORM="$(mktemp)"
tr '\\' '/' < "$LCOV" > "$NORM"
for f in "$@"; do
  added=$(git diff -U0 "$BASE" -- "$f" | awk '/^@@/{split($3,a,","); s=substr(a[1],2); c=(a[2]==""?1:a[2]); for(i=0;i<c;i++) print s+i}' | tr '\n' ' ')
  awk -F'[:,]' -v want="$f" -v added="$added" '
    BEGIN { n = split(added, arr, " "); for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) A[arr[i]] = 1 }
    /^SF:/ { cur = substr($0, 4) }
    /^DA:/ && cur == want { if (!($2 in H) || $3 > H[$2]) H[$2] = $3 }
    /^BRDA:/ && cur == want { k = $2 "," $3 "," $4; v = ($5 == "-" ? 0 : $5); if (!(k in B) || v > B[k]) B[k] = v; BL[k] = $2 }
    END {
      tot = 0; unc = ""
      for (l in A) if (l in H) { tot++; if (H[l] == 0) unc = unc " " l }
      bt = 0; bu = ""
      for (k in B) if (BL[k] in A) { bt++; if (B[k] == 0) bu = bu " " BL[k] }
      printf "%s: changed lines %d, uncovered:%s | changed branches %d, uncovered at line:%s\n", want, tot, (unc == "" ? " none" : unc), bt, (bu == "" ? " none" : bu)
    }' "$NORM"
done
rm -f "$NORM"

```

# Phase 4 checkpoint: rendering, hit-testing, binding, export

## 1. Summary

The canvas, clicks, arrow binding and PNG/SVG export now follow the local layer order, and nothing shared changes. 47 new tests pass, the full suite has no new failures, and the work is committed as `0d1f6278` (not pushed).

**About "your own row missing from a stored order".** This can't happen with real data, and old data is already handled the way you described:

- Your own id is recorded in #116's directory when the room starts ([Collab.tsx:536](excalidraw-app/collab/Collab.tsx#L536)), and the stored order is built from that directory. So your current row is always in it.
- Your drawings from an older tab or session have a different creator id. #116 already lists that id as a "Previously seen" row if it's in the directory, otherwise under Miscellaneous.

No change needed. The case I raised only shows up in a hand-built test fixture.

**Everything now goes through `orderElementsByCollaboratorLayer`.** Every path that decides "what's on top" uses that one function:

| Path | Change |
| --- | --- |
| **Canvas** ([Renderer.ts](packages/excalidraw/scene/Renderer.ts)) | Orders the elements before building its cached element map. The layer order is part of the cache key. It's an optional option, so #116's test calls are unchanged. |
| **Clicks** ([App.tsx](packages/excalidraw/components/App.tsx)) | `getElementsAtPosition` and the text-tool container pick now use a new `getElementsInDrawingOrder()`. It's cached per scene change and layer order, and while layering is off it returns the scene's own array at no cost. |
| **Arrow binding** | #116's `getBindableElements()` feeds all 9 App binding call sites. It and the `binding.ts`/`focus.ts` chokepoints now see candidates in drawing order. `zindex.ts` stays on the shared order, because it computes shared indices. |
| **Export** ([scene/export.ts](packages/excalidraw/scene/export.ts)) | The ordering happens inside the existing `prepareElementsForRender`, as you asked; there's no new export function. It runs after `syncInvalidIndices` and outside the embedded-scene JSON. `exportCanvas` passes the layering fields along for SVG. |
| **Actions** (in #81's `actionCollaboratorVisibility.ts`) | `toggleCollaboratorLayering` stores the default order the first time it's switched on and keeps it when switched off. `moveCollaboratorLayer` and `resetCollaboratorLayerOrder` do nothing while the switch is off. All three use `CaptureUpdateAction.NEVER`. |

**Performance safeguard.** `collaborators` becomes a new `Map` on every cursor update from a peer. To stop that from clearing the caches, `getLocalLayerOrder()` returns the _same_ array until the order's contents actually change.

- **The three uncovered paths.** They use the same function, but no test reaches them yet.
- **Arrow binding and hiding/locking.** Binding is now the one place where layering and #116/#81 interact beyond drawing: an arrow binds to the top shape in my layering, and #81's amended AC E still allows binding to a locked shape. I followed what you approved, but no AC explicitly covers binding to a locked shape that's on top in my layering.
- **Frames from different collaborators.** If a frame and its child have different owners, the child can be drawn above or below the frame's border, depending on my layering. Clipping is unaffected, and AC D only requires clipping, so I left it. It's a visual difference to watch for in manual testing.
- **Elbow-arrow routing** (`elbowArrow.ts`) passes candidates through its own path, not one of the chokepoints. It still uses the shared order for re-routing. I left it, since it isn't binding a new arrow; tell me if you want it included.
- **Interactive canvas.** Selection outlines and handles don't depend on element order, so I didn't route them.

## Decisions log

- Initial order derived from the dropdown sections or from the shared order → **join order, you on top**, kept when the switch is turned off and on → a familiar starting order that keeps your changes.
- No Reset button → **a Reset order button** that returns to join order with you on top → matches the issue scenario.
- AC H while the switch is off → **covered by the join order** → no separate rule needed.
- Embeddables can't be layered → **accepted: skip embeddables** → they are drawn above the canvas.
- Numeric grid layer → **leave it, log as tech debt** → simple fix later.
- Export → **no new function; order inside the existing `prepareElementsForRender`** → avoid redundant export code.
- Separate join-order field (`collaboratorJoinOrder`) → **reuse #116's `collaboratorDirectory` insertion order** → use existing infrastructure.
- Your own row pinned on top → **on top only by default; you can move it after a reset** → matches the issue's resolved question.
- Reset also disabled when the order is already the default → **Reset grayed out only while layering is off**; [Layering switch][reset order] in one row directly above the rows → your layout choice.
- Previously seen order: oldest first or newest first as stored → **newest first, as #116 already loads them** → no change to #116 code.
- Binding stays on the shared order → **binding and the text-container pick use the layered order** → the arrow binds to what's drawn on top.
- Phase 2 tests → **approved; check coverage after every implementation step and go over the gaps together later** → hard to judge tests fully before the code exists.
- My proposal to add tests for the coverage gaps now → **add them after the Stryker run, for review** → review them together with the mutation results.
- Committing the regenerated SVG font snapshots → **leave tests and snapshots unchanged unless they relate directly to #82** → the font failures are most likely from the recent font feature.
- Your own row missing from a stored order → **old data belongs in Miscellaneous (or its own "Previously seen" row), as #116 already does** → confirmed that no change is needed.
- Where the actions go → **Phase 4, as planned**.

## Tech debt

**Introduced:**

- The default order depends on `collaboratorDirectory` keeping keys in insertion order. That is how `Map` works, but nothing in the code states it as a rule.
- **New:** `collabLayer.test.tsx` copies about 60 lines of socket, encryption and Firebase mocks from `collabLock.test.tsx`, because `vi.mock` applies per file. #81 had the same duplication.
- **New:** the ordering runs in two cached places: the renderer's element cache and App's `getElementsInDrawingOrder`. Both call the same function, so they can't disagree, but each pays for its own sort when the scene changes.
- **New:** tests run actions by name (`actionManager.actions[name]`), as #81's do, so a renamed action is caught by the tests rather than the type checker.

**Encountered:**

- `exportToCanvas` rewrites element indices through `syncInvalidIndices`.
- The numeric grid layer assumes drawing order matches index order.
- Embeddables are drawn above the canvas and can't be layered.
- The renderer's cache key must list every local setting that affects ordering.
- `yarn prettier <files>` formats the whole repo.
- The directory is saved sorted by `lastSeen`, so previously seen collaborators load newest first.
- `newElement`/`newTextElement` accept `id` at runtime, but their option types don't.
- 3 SVG font snapshots in `scene/__snapshots__/export.test.ts.snap` already fail on the untouched branch, likely from the recent font feature.
- **New:** elbow-arrow routing (`elbowArrow.ts`) finds hovered elements through its own path, outside the binding chokepoints.

Waiting for "Approved" before Phase 5 (UI).

```text
import clsx from "clsx";

import "./Switch.scss";

export type SwitchProps = {
  name: string;
  checked: boolean;
  title?: string;
  onChange: (value: boolean) => void;
  disabled?: boolean;
};

export const Switch = ({
  title,
  name,
  checked,
  onChange,
  disabled = false,
}: SwitchProps) => {
  return (
    <div className={clsx("Switch", { toggled: checked, disabled })}>
      <input
        name={name}
        id={name}
        title={title}
        type="checkbox"
        checked={checked}
        disabled={disabled}
        onChange={() => onChange(!checked)}
        onKeyDown={(event) => {
          if (event.key === " ") {
            onChange(!checked);
          }
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
};
```
